questions.question:
Rakesh invests 10,000 rupees in a fixed deposit scheme for 2 years at 5% per annum compound interest. How much amount will he receive on maturity of fixed deposit?

A. Rs. 10,000

B. Rs. 8500

C. Rs. 11,050

D. Rs. 11,025
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rakesh invests 10,000 rupees in a fixed deposit scheme for 2 years at 5% per annum compound interest.

**Formula used:**

Amount = P × (1 + R/100)T

P = Principal

R = rate %

T = time

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

P = Rs. 10,000, R = 5%, T = 2 years

Amount = P × (1 + R/100)T

⇒ Amount = 10,000 × (1 + 5/100)²

⇒ 10,000 × 105 × 105/10,000

⇒ Rs. 11,025

**∴ He will **receive **Rs. 11,025 on maturity of fixed deposit amount.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] **

Amount = principal + compound interest

⇒ 10000 + 1025

⇒ Rs. 11025

∴ He will receive Rs. 11,025 on maturity of fixed deposit amount.

questions.question:
If the ratio of the angles of a triangle is 2 : 3 : 5, find the ratio of the sum of the largest angle and the smallest angle to the smallest angle.

A. 7 : 2

B. 2 : 3

C. 7 : 1

D. 3 : 5
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of a triangle = 2 : 3 : 5

**Concept:**

The sum of the three angles of a triangle is 180° 

**Calculation:**

Let, the smallest angle be 2x

The medium angel be 3x 

The largest angle be 5x

According to the question:

⇒ 2x + 3x + 5x = 180° 

⇒ 10x = 180° 

⇒ x = 18° 

Now,

The smallest angle = 2x = 2 × 18 = 36° 

The medium angel = 3x = 3 × 18 = 54° 

The largest angle = 5x = 5 × 18 = 90° 

Again, 

(The largest angle + The smallest angle) : The smallest angle.

⇒ (90° + 36°) : 36° 

⇒ 126° : 36° = 7 : 2

**∴ The ratio of the sum of the largest angle and the smallest angle to the smallest angle 7 : 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

The ratio of the given ratios will be equal to the ratio of the actual values of the angles.

According to the question:

(The largest angle + The smallest angle) : The smallest angle

⇒ (5 + 2) : 2 = 7 : 2

∴ The ratio of the sum of the largest angle and the smallest angle to the smallest angle 7 : 2.

Neelam and Manisha start running from the same place at the speed of 7 km/h and 9 km/h respectively. If they move in the same direction, how long will they take to go 16 km away from each other?

B. 8 hours

C. 10 hours

D. 12 hours
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Neelam = 7 km/h

Speed of Manisha = 9 km/h

**Concept used:**

When two bodies move in same direction then the relative speed is difference of speed.

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Speed = Distance/Time

Time = Distance /Speed

**Calculation:**

Let they will take be t hours to 16 km apart,

According to the question:

Distance travelled by Neelam = (7 × t)km = 7t km

Distance travelled by Neelam = (9 × t)km = 9t km

Now, Relative speed = (9t – 7t) = 16

⇒ 2t = 16

⇒ t = 8

**∴ They will take time 8 hours**.

questions.question:
Find the largest number which on dividing 60, 150, and 285 leaves equal remainder in each.

A. 30

B. 25

C. 45

D. 55
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers are 60, 150, and 285

**Concept Used:**

To find the HCF of bigger numbers take the difference between the numbers and find the HCF of differences.

**Solution:**

The largest which divides the given numbers 

i.e. We need to find the HCF of given numbers.

⇒ 150 – 60 = 90

⇒ 285 – 150 = 135

⇒ 285 – 60 = 225

Now finding the HCF of 90, 135, and 225

⇒ 90 = __3 × 3 × 5__ × 2

⇒ 135 = __3 × 3 × 5 __× 3

⇒ 225 = __3 × 3× 5__ × 5

⇒ HCF of given numbers = 3 × 3 × 5

⇒ HCF = 45

**∴ The largest number which will give the same remainder is 45.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bd67c9563cdde4a0dfe99b7686282bc07365f691adfb64c907de66aebe4b011.png] **

By using options we can solve this question,

**Option 1, **

⇒ 30 exactly divides 60 and 150 but does not divide 285 

⇒ Option 1 is incorrect.

**Option 2,**

⇒ 25 exactly divides 150 but does not divide 60 and 285

⇒ Option 2 is incorrect.

**Option 4,**

⇒ When we divide 60 by 55, we get the remainder as 5

⇒ When we divide 150 by 55, we get the remainder as 40

⇒ We get the different remainder

⇒ Option 4 is incorrect.

**Option 3,**

⇒ When we divide 60 by 45, we get the remainder as 15

⇒ When we divide 150 by 45, we get the remainder as 15

⇒ When we divide 285 by 45, we get the remainder as 15

⇒ Option 3 is correct

∴ The largest number which will give the same remainder is 45.
